approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: Finance teams receive the same information in a different shape from every source. Statements arrive in inconsistent formats and are reconciled by hand, invoices are keyed one at a time, and expense claims scatter across systems before anyone can approve them.
script.vo02: Travel adds currency conversion to the same manual work.
script.vo03: It reads Submitted financial statements, Invoices and purchase orders. It engages you in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Outlook. And it can extract and normalise statements arriving in inconsistent formats, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: A finance lead asks the agent to reconcile the month's submitted statements. It normalises the formats, matches the values across sources, and returns the exceptions rather than the whole pile.
script.vo05: Asked for a plan, the agent orders the exceptions by what is blocking the close, proposes a correction for each, and separates the ones a person must judge.
script.vo06: On risk, the agent explains what approving the remainder would assume, names the claims it could not verify against policy, and leaves the decision with finance.
script.vo_payoff: Finance teams spend their time on the exceptions rather than on retyping what was already sent.
script.vo_helps: The result? Less hand-keying, submissions from many sources made comparable, and a shorter wait between a submission and a decision.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
